notes.title: JASON – Development almost complete & release planned for mid-September!
notes.notes:
The development of JASON: Coming of Age – Part One is now almost complete!


[previewyoutube="XDPt2dDKXO4;full"][/previewyoutube]

The game is currently under review by the Steam validation team. The latest feedback pointed out some overly realistic content, but thanks to the clarifications received and the adjustments made, everything has now been corrected.

👉 There are still a few code fixes to apply and the full integration of videos to finalize, but the project is in its final stage. If no further blocking elements are identified, the release should take place around September 21.

At launch, the game will be accompanied by two DLCs:

Integrated Walkthrough, to guide you if needed.

Realism Pack 2.0 (images + videos), released separately so as not to delay the main game if its review takes longer.

A bundle including the base game and both DLCs will also be available at a competitive price in line with other adult visual novels.

📊 Some numbers to give you a sense of scale:

~9,500 dialogue blocks (~100,000 words)

~6,500 scenes

230 animations (600+ with the Realism DLC)

Over 100 original music tracks

26 characters, with 8 potential Love Interests

20 Steam achievements to unlock

In French, Part One already represents 6 to 8 hours of gameplay at minimum, depending on your level of exploration.

Thank you all for your patience and support. Fingers crossed for the final validation 🙏

notes.title: Here’s the latest update on the game’s development
notes.notes:
Here’s the latest update on the game’s development.

I’ve nearly finished JASON Coming of Age – Part 1, and I really hope to bring it to you here on Steam very soon.
Right now, the build is under review by the Valve team.

I had to make changes to some of the renders, which turned out to be the most time-consuming part of the process. Some images were flagged as too realistic.
The tricky part is: Steam doesn’t tell you which images are problematic, and the game includes over 6,000 renders… So when everything looks fine on my end, it becomes extremely difficult to fix anything specific.

Since some of you are asking for updates here, I wanted to share what’s going on.
The first time I submitted the build, it took about three weeks to get feedback. I made the requested changes and just resubmitted a new build today, focused solely on render validation.
Fingers crossed the feedback from Valve will be constructive — otherwise, it could take a while.

I also updated the store page description to better explain what JASON – Part 1 is, based on some previous feedback from Steam.

Just to be clear: Part 1 will be fully complete in terms of gameplay, scenes, and story — no more changes planned once it’s out.
That said, JASON is designed to grow over time. With so many Love Interests (LIs), future updates will come in the form of DLCs, adding new story arcs and allowing the MC to expand his harem or meet new characters. (More info in the  store page description.)

As for the NSFW videos, I have a lot to add.
But I’m not including them in the main build for now, because I’m not sure how Steam will react. Even though the content features no real actors — it’s all created from my own models — not everyone sees it that way.
To avoid any risk of rejection or violating the rules, I plan to release these videos as a separate DLC, pending approval.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to ask!
Just a heads-up: I don’t get notifications when new messages are posted here, even though everything seems to be set up correctly. So if I don’t reply right away, that’s why.
But the official Discord server is open, and I’m there every day.

See you soon,
❤ Coeur de Cochon

notes.title: JASON – Final Sprint Before Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/4f90b1db2949c0492c09a6c2d293fee8ca8c4e97.jpg

Hey everyone,
Just wanted to share some updates on the development of JASON, as we’re now entering the final sprint before release.

Originally planned for April, the launch has now been rescheduled for early summer, just after June’s Neo Fest.
This little delay gives me the time to polish everything and ensure a smoother experience for everyone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/fd7ff512eaf69ad6d2cf5949ac3b1946669196ec.jpg

🔧 Where are we now?

The visual production — including all 3D renders and cinematic videos — is about 85% complete.
Just in April, I produced over 1,000 new renders, and the final game should include close to 5,000!

May is fully dedicated to coding and finishing up the remaining features, including:

    The timeline system

    Free roam mode

    In-game help system

    MC attributes and progression stats

The game is designed to be highly branching, meaning the main story can be experienced through multiple paths, creating different playthroughs depending on your choices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/3342f842946588951f4e16733fa37b9ed22231e7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/be49c3ddc504356e2600a2e6313b781ac1869255.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/b6ed44220a36b4387b3c664ba5cd9df72f626906.jpg

❤️ What kind of game is JASON?

JASON is a harem-style narrative game, where one main storyline unfolds alongside multiple side plots.
The core of the experience lies in the relationships you build (or not) with other characters. Whether you focus on one love interest or explore several, the story adapts to your choices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/6ee25f9f1e62582efbb3834ac10e728afa83d376.jpg

This first episode is packed with twists and turns, while also laying the foundations for the wider JASON universe.
And yes, there will be a sequel — but let’s not get ahead of ourselves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/440395f643828eaec1f203be1aa85098f38d37eb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302270/d70b275d2e37ae17ebac2273f3150e3a05f22d21.jpg

Beyond the main story...

Remember Jason’s dream sequences from the demo?
There will be more! I’ll be including side stories and dream-like episodes to expand Jason’s world even further... but I’m keeping a bit of mystery for now.

I'm also attaching a few recent visuals I’ve created, just to give you a little taste of what’s coming.

Thanks again for your patience and support — I promise, it’ll be worth the wait!
